# Synthetic document fixtures

`synthetic-ttrinh.docx` is generated test data for the SEP-20 structural import case. It contains placeholder document identifiers, repeated synthetic body paragraphs and a generic signer label. The organization/header strings exercise the existing company profile contract; this file is not an issued document or a legal template.

The fixture replaces the test's dependency on a locally ignored pilot document. Do not add the private reference archive or actual personnel documents here.
